question: What will be the present value of Rs. 13,230 due two years hence, when the interest is compounded at the rate of 5% per annum?
solution:
Given:

Rs. 13,230 due two years hence, when the interest is compounded at the rate of 5% per annum

Formula used:

In compound interest,

Amount = Principal × (1 + r / 100)n

Calculation:

Let, P is the principal

As per the question,

13230 = P × (1 + 5 / 100)2 .

⇒ 13230 = P × (21/20)2 .

​⇒ P = Rs 12000

∴ The correct option is 4
